title: Recidivism
row_label: The information on 'Recidivism' was available in respect of 14,25,086 offenders out of which 13,23,922, i.e., 92.9 percent were new offenders. The percentage of persons who were convicted once, twice and three or more was 4.8 percent, 1.6 percent and 0.7 percent, respectively. 9.3 percent of the persons arrested for

columns.name: the offence of 'Dacoity' were convicted in the past and this accounted for the highest percentage of recidivism closely followed by Burglary (8.7 percent). The relevant statistics in respect of number of offenders and their percentage distribution of 'Recidivism' are presented in Tables 53 and 54.
